text: Kicking is the foundation of swimming, providing the power needed to move through the water. As a beginner, focusing on powerful, fluid kicks will help you build the strength and endurance necessary for swimming. Proper kicking technique ensures that your body is efficient in generating propulsion, and it helps prevent fatigue. As you gain confidence, you can gradually incorporate breathing, which allows for better oxygen intake and aids in maintaining a relaxed posture. By mastering kicks first, swimmers establish a solid base before advancing to more complex maneuvers like breathing, ensuring a balanced and effective swimming experience.
